name: canrun-13.4.0
description: Says whether a Steam game can run on this PC and gives an FPS range when one is known.

functions.name: check_compatibility
functions.description: Check one Steam game against this PC and give its expected FPS range. When the user asks about a Steam Deck, Steam Machine, Steam Frame or SteamOS, keep that in game_name, for example 'Elden Ring on Steam Deck', and the answer adds the Steam device ratings. Use it for questions such as 'canrun Cyberpunk 2077?', 'Can I run ARC Raiders?', 'Can I run Elden Ring?', 'How will Starfield run on my PC?' or 'What FPS will I get in Hades II?'. Call it for every game name, including new releases you do not recognize: CanRun looks the title up on Steam itself. Pass only the game name, exactly as the user wrote it. The returned text is the full answer. Show that text to the user unchanged.

game_name.description: The game name exactly as the user wrote it, letter for letter, even if you do not know the game

functions.name: detect_hardware
functions.description: Report the GPU, CPU, RAM, and display on this PC. Show the returned text unchanged.

functions.name: auto_detect
functions.description: Read a whole question such as 'canrun Cyberpunk 2077?', 'Can I run ARC Raiders?', 'Can I run Diablo IV?' or 'How will Starfield run on my PC?' and answer with the check, for any game title. Show the returned text unchanged.

user_input.description: Natural language user input to parse and analyze
